paite: Huan kum thum sung Siriate leh Israelte kidou lou in a-om uhi.
heading: Zawlnei Mikaiah In Ahab Avauhilh / (2 Kro 18.2-27)

paite: Akum thum kum in hichi ahong hi a, Israel kumpipa kiang ah Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat ahohsuk hi.
Israel kumpipa'n asikhate kiang ah, "Ramoth-gilead khua ei a ahi chih thei napi a, bangchidan a Siria kumpipa khut a pan sutkhe lou a mawk om i hi ua oi?" achi hi.

Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ramoth-gilead ah galdou ding in kei toh na hong kuan diam?" achi hi. Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Kei leh nang, ka mite leh na mite pum khat i hi ua, ka sakol leh na sakol pum khat ahi ve ua le," achi hi.
Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Tuni in TOUPA thu dong in, chi in ka hon ngen," achi hi.

Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n zawlnei mi zali asamkhawm a, akiang uah, "Ramoth-gilead khua dou ding in ka kuantou diam, kuantou lou ding?" achi hi. Amau, "Kuan in, Toupa'n kumpipa khut ah ahon pe ding,” achi uh.
Himahleh Jehoshaphat in, "Hiai ah TOUPA zawlnei dang kuahiam bek i dot ding om lou hia?" achi hi.

Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "TOUPA hon dotsak ding mi khat Imlah tapa Mikaiah om lai veh aw. Himahleh amah ka hua hi; ka tungtang thu ahoih lou lam lou ngal agen ngei kei," achi hi. Jehoshaphat in, "Kumpipa'n hichibang in chi kei hen," achi hi.
Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n heutu khat asam a, "Kintak in Imlah tapa Mikaiah va pi mah dih," achi hi.
Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat bel Samaria kongpi lutna gei phaizang ah akumpipa uh puan a kithuam in alaltutphah tuaktuak uah atu ua, zawlnei tengteng in ama uah thu agen uhi.
Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in sik kiite abawlsak a, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hiaite in Siriate mangthang sipsip khop in na hihse ding chi in," achi hi.
Huchi mah bang in zawlnei tengteng in, "Ramoth-gilead ah va hohtou inla, va lohching in, TOUPA'N kumpipa khut ah ahon pe ding," chi in agen uhi.

Mikaiah sam dia sawl a ompa'n akiang ah, "Ngai dih, zawlneite'n thukhat sat in ahoih lam in kumpipa kiang ah thu agen chiat uh. Agen khitsa bang un gen sam inla, ahoih lam in va gen in," chi in angen hi.
Mikaiah in, "TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi, TOUPA'N ka kiang ah agen mah ka va gen ding," achi hi.

Kumpipa kiang atuntouh in, kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Mikaiah, Ramoth-gilead khua dou ding in ka kuantou diam, kuantou lou ding?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Kuantou inla, va lohching in; TOUPA'N kumpipa khut ah ahon pe ding," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n akiang ah, “Thutak kia lou ngal ka kiang a TOUPA min agen lou dia bangzah vei ahia ka hon kichiamsak ding?" achi hi.
Ama'n, "Israel tengteng ching ding nei lou belam bang in tang a dalhzak in ka mu hi. TOUPA'N, hiaite'n heutu aneita kei ua, michih ama inn chiat ah lungmuangtak in pai hen achi," achi hi.
Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ka tungtang thu ahoih lou lam kia lou ngal, ahoih lam himhim agen kei ding chih ka hon hilh ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
Ama'n, "Huaiziak in TOUPA thu ngaikhe dih, TOUPA alaltutphah tung a tu, van a mipi tengteng ataklam leh veilam a dinghte toh ka mu hi.
TOUPA'N, Ramoth-gilead a hohtou a, gal a si dia kua'n Ahab kunzou ding ahia? achi hi. Khat in hichibang in, midang in huchibang in," achi uh.
Huchi in kha khat ahong pawt a, TOUPA ma ah adingh a, "Ke'n ka kunzou ding," achi hi.

TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Bang in eita? achi hi. Ama'n ka va hoh dia, azawlnei teng muk ah kha zuauthei ka va suak ding, achi hi. Ama'n va kun mah inla, na lohching lai ding. Va kuan inla, huchibang in va hih ve leh," achi hi.
"Huaiziak in tu in ngai in, TOUPA'N hiai na zawlnei teng muk ah kha zuauthei akoih a, na tungtang thu ahoih lou lam TOUPA'N agen khinta," achi hi.
Huchi in Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in ahon naih a, Mikaiah biang ahong beng a, "TOUPA Kha in na kiang a thu gen ding in kei a pan koilam ah ahia apai?" achi hi.
Mikaiah in, "Ngai in, dantan sunggil a kibu dia na lut ni in na thei ding," achi hi.
Israel kumpipa'n, "Mikaiah pi unla, khopi ukpipa Ammon leh kumpi tapa Joash kiang ah paipih nawn un," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n hichi in achi, "Hiai mi suangkul ah khum unla, galmuang a ka hong pai nawn masiah gimthuakna an leh gimthuakna tui na pia un," achi hi.
Mikaiah in, "Galmuang a na hong pai nawnleh TOUPA'N kei zang a thu gen lou ahi ding," achi hi. Amah mah in, "Nou, mipite aw, na vek un na za un," achi hi.
Huchi in Ramoth-gilead ah Israel kumpipa leh Jehoshaphat ahohtou uh.
heading: Ahab Sihna / (2 Kro 18.28-34)

paite: Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ka kibawl lamdang dia, kidouna ah ka hohtou dia; nang bel na kumpi puan silh in," achi hi. Huchi in Israel kumpipa akibawl lamdang a, kidouna ah ahohtou hi.
Siria kumpipa'n akangtalai tung a heutu sawmthum-le-nihte kiang ah, "Israel kumpipa kia lou ngal mineu leng, milian leng akuamah sual kei un," chi in thu apia hi.
Kangtalai tung a heutute'n Jehoshaphat amuh un, hichi ahong hi a, "Israel kumpipa ahi mah ve," achi uh. Huchi in sual tum in a-umta ua; Jehoshaphat akikoukhia hi.
Kangtalai tung a heutute'n Israel kumpipa ana hi kei chih atheih un hichi ahong hi a, adelh lai uh anungkiksan uhi.

Mi khat in tup tuam nei lou in athalpeu alai a, Israel kumpipa kithopna kikaltak ah akapkhata hi. Huchi in akangtalai hawlpa kiang ah, "Kaihei inla, sepaihte lak a pan hon pawtpih in, ka liam," achi hi.
Huai ni in kidouna athupi mahmah a; kumpipa akangtalai tung a kingai in Siriate lam nga in a-opsuk a, nitaklam in asita a; aliamna a pan sisan kangtalai sung ah aluang hi.
Nitum kuan in sepaihte lak ah, "Michih amah khua ah, michih amah gam ah pai vek hen," chi in thu puankhiak ahi.
Huchi in kumpipa asita a, Samaria khua alutpih ua; huchi in Samaria ah kumpipa avui uh.
Samaria khua dil khat ah kangtalai asil ua; TOUPA thugen bang in uite'n asisan aliaksiang ua, agalvan leng asilsiang uh. Huai dil bel kizuakte kisilna dil ahi.
Huchi in Ahab tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, saiha inn alamte, akhosat tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in apute kiang ah Ahab a-ihmuta a; asik in atapa Ahaziah ahong lalta hi.
Israel kumpipa Ahab lal akum lina ah, Judahte tung ah Asa tapa Jehoshaphat alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jehoshaphat

paite: Jehoshaphat alal kipat in kum sawmthum-le-nga ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-nga vai ahawm hi. Anu min Azubah ahi a, amah Shilhi tanu ahi.
Apa Asa lampi tot tengteng atawn a; pialsan het lou in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi. Himahleh mun sangte alamang kei a, mun sangte ah mite kithoih lai in gimlim ahal lailai uhi.
Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa toh kilemna abawl hi.
Huchi in Jehoshaphat tanchin dangte, athilhihtheihdan ahihlat thute, agaldou thute Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Apa Asa dam lai a pasal kizuak omlaite, agam a pan adelhkhe vek hi.
Edom gam ah kumpipa a-om kei a, thuneihna piaksawn mi khat in vai ahawm hi.
Jehoshaphat in Ophir a pai a dangka-eng po ding Tarshish longte abawl hi. Himahleh Ezion-geber mun ah longte asiat khit vek ziak in ahohta kei hi.
Huchi in Ahab tapa Ahaziah in Jehoshaphat kiang ah, na sikhate toh longte ah ka sikhate kuankhawm le uh ake, achi a; himahleh Jehoshaphat in lem asa kei.
Huchi in apute kiang ah Jehoshaphat a-ihmuta a, apute lak ah apu David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Jehoram alalta hi.
Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat lal akum sawm-le-sagih kum in Samaria ah, Israelte tung ah Ahab tapa Ahaziah alal pan a, Israelte tung ah kum nih alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Ahaziah

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a, anu leh apa lampi totte, Nebat tapa Israelte thil hihkhialsakpa Jeroboam lampi totte atawn sam hi.
Apa hih teng hih in Baal nna sem in abia a, TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian ahehsak hi.
